rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese word for an optical instrument used to observe very small objects.

example.english: You need a microscope to see these bacteria clearly.
example.traditional: 用顯微鏡先睇得清楚呢啲細菌。
example.jyutping: jung6 hin2 mei4 geng3 sin1 dai6 dak1 cing1 co2 ni1 di1 sai3 kwan2
